paragraphs.text: Being chased by the fury of his enemies into a strange country, he was a dumb dove not seeking vengeance.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He shows that if God will help him, it must be now or never for all the world is against him and ready to devour him.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He stays his conscience on God's promise though he sees no present help.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: All my counsels have evil success, and turn to my own sorrow.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: As all the world against one man, and cannot be satisfied unless they have my life.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: They not only think to escape punishment, but the more wicked they are, the more impudent they grow.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: If God stores the tears of his saints, much more will he remember their blood, to avenge it: and though tyrants burn the bones, yet they cannot blot the tears and blood out of God's register.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Having received that which I required, I am bound to pay my vows of thanksgiving as I promised.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: As mindful of his great mercies, and giving thanks for the same.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: That is, in the life and light of the sun.
paragraphs.label: k
